subs: Not every coding task needs the most powerful model.
A typo fix and a cross-module race condition are very different jobs,
yet most workflows send both to the same expensive tier.
Meet Adaptive Codex Router:
a local, usage-aware wrapper for the Codex CLI.
cues.say: Meet Adaptive Codex Router: a local, usage-aware wrapper for the Codex C L I.

subs: It plans every task first, then routes it to the cheapest
model and reasoning effort that is likely to succeed.
Step one: plan.
A local Qwen3.8-27B model analyzes your repository,
so planning spends none of your Codex allowance.
cues.say: A local Kwen three point eight, twenty-seven B model analyzes your repository, so planning spends none of your Codex allowance.

subs: It returns a structured plan: task type, relevant files,
implementation steps, risks, and verification.
If the local model is offline, auto mode falls back to Luna,
then to a deterministic classifier.
A planner failure never blocks your coding task.
Step two: route.
A deterministic policy picks the model and reasoning effort
across four tiers: Luna, Terra, Sol, and Astra.
A typo goes to Luna on low.
A new feature gets Terra on medium.
A tricky race condition goes to Sol on high.
Planners can only suggest a tier. The policy decides,
and Astra's most expensive settings stay behind explicit guardrails.
Step three: execute and verify.
The chosen model edits your Git working tree in a sandbox,
and objective checks decide whether it really succeeded.
If it fails, the router looks at why and escalates to a stronger route,
with up to three attempts by default.
Every run is logged as privacy-conscious telemetry,
and prompts stay out of the logs unless you opt in.
A local dashboard shows tokens, latency, models,
and attempts as they happen.
And the project stays honest about evidence.
On forty calibration tasks, routing was 95% exact,
with zero under-routes.
cues.say: On forty calibration tasks, routing was ninety-five percent exact, with zero under-routes.

subs: A SWE-bench Verified harness is ready, but no savings are claimed
